verdict.rationale: Synthesia documents one batch-style operation: the Localization API localizes a video into up to 20 languages in a single request. Its Video API is pitched for generating templated videos "at scale," but that appears to mean repeated asynchronous job submission rather than a true bulk endpoint. missing for 10: documented bulk endpoints or UI actions that act on many existing videos/items at once (bulk create, edit, delete, export), batch limits and semantics, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Localization API — localize your videos into up to 20 languages per request.
Video API — generate finished video files: scripted avatar videos, dubbing, translation, and templates at scale.
